meaning_of_pass: Independent bytes/source bindings and numeric reconstruction passed; this says nothing about physical fragment validity, convergence, calibration, surface response, grid bias, or fracture dissipation.
scope: single completed free-fracture pilot attempt; no solver invocation

spatial_and_grip_association.interpretation_boundary: All labels here describe connected components of the active canonical-bond graph only; they do not identify physical fragments or a crack surface.
spatial_and_grip_association.event_subset_plot_policy: If more than 500 first-break events exist, plot 500 deterministically evenly spaced event-order samples including first and last; machine audit retains all event rows and checks.
spatial_and_grip_association.right_grip_incident_reference_layer_pair: Canonical pairs are counted once with sorted reference x-layer indices; event counts come from independently coordinate-recomputed first breaks.

independent_recomputation.damage_definition: 1 - active_bond_count_at_state / reference_neighbor_count, recomputed from the irreversible active canonical roster
independent_recomputation.strict_failure_rule: fail_permit && stretch > critical_stretch; for threshold gaps within 128*epsilon(Float64) roundoff band, the event record is accepted only as an explicitly counted ambiguous comparison and its coordinates/length/stretch/threshold are still cross-checked
independent_recomputation.graph_definition: connected components of currently active canonical bonds; all point IDs are included, including graph-isolated points
independent_recomputation.kinetic_energy_semantics: raw 0.5 * mass * |stored full-step V|^2; free and grip-masked contributions are reported separately. Native BC constrains vhalf, while stored full-step V includes post-force acceleration half-step, so physical KE at constrained grips is UNKNOWN.
independent_recomputation.energy_balance_status: diagnostic only; no fracture-dissipation or energy-closure qualification

evidence.status: raw solver diagnostic; constrained-grip physical KE UNKNOWN

native_arithmetic_validation.meaning: Numerical agreement of frozen native states, event/graph reconstructions, mechanics and energy-reaction columns only; no physical qualification.

evidence.status: raw solver diagnostic; constrained-grip physical KE UNKNOWN

geometry_event_sampling.method: all events if <=500; otherwise 500 evenly spaced event-order samples including first and last
geometry_event_sampling.deformation_scale: actual coordinates in millimetres; no magnification
